integrity: The proof is analytic; finite computational checks only corroborate the example and do not amount to independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Requires a unique, symmetric, nondegenerate quartic flattening with positive curvature elsewhere; excludes higher-contact, asymmetric, and simultaneous local defects. The Pascal limaçon corollary covers only 0<q<1. Claimed originality remains provisional.
title: Fractional convexification laws at a symmetric quartic dimple, with an exact limaçon model
